source_lineage.C179#1: Secondary NORAD 528 TLE, not instrumental covariance
source_lineage.C197#1: NASA/Goddard SSR dated 1963-11-15, p.8; only the cataloged day 1963-11-08 of decay, no time/place

variables.C0: 6x6 Cartesian covariance, axes [r km, v km/s] at a declared UTC epoch
variables.delta_axis: plus/minus multiplier times each column L[:,i] (12 controls)
variables.delta_mixed: multiplier/sqrt(2) times (plus/minus L[:,i] plus/minus L[:,j]) for i<j (60 controls)
variables.residual: RK4_J2(x0+delta)-RK4_J2(x0)-Phi delta, separately in km and km/s

equation_edges: same Mahalanobis norm for all 72 deterministic probes: delta^T inv(C0) delta = multiplier^2
pair combinations test off-diagonal second-order response missed by axial-only probes
reject if any probe is nonfinite, hits conditional reentry event, or exceeds stated remainder budget
falsifier: Synthetic cross term F(u)=u0*u1 has zero residual on all 12 axes but nonzero residual on mixed pairs. This is a mathematical control, not a historical physical measurement.
scope_limit: 72 finite directions are not a global ellipsoid bound, stochastic probability, atmospheric calibration, or physical holdout
missing_dependencies: original NORAD 527/529 Cartesian measurements with epoch/frame/covariance
authenticated 1963 orientation / EOP / UT1 and frame uncertainty
historical observation independence and calibrated out-of-sample validation
